description: Source code implementing PKCS#12 import/export and related cryptographic functions within the mozilla_security_manager namespace, including handling of certificates and private keys using NSS libraries.

methods.name: unicodeToItem
methods.description: Converts a UTF-16 string to an SECItem buffer, handling byte order.

methods.name: write_export_data
methods.description: Callback to write data into a string buffer during PKCS#12 encoding.

methods.name: nickname_collision
methods.description: Handles nickname collisions during PKCS#12 import, generating a new nickname for certificates.

methods.name: pip_ucs2_ascii_conversion_fn
methods.description: No-op conversion function for UCS2 to ASCII, since input is already Unicode.

methods.name: nsPKCS12Blob_ImportHelper
methods.description: Imports PKCS#12 data, verifying and extracting certificates and keys, handling errors.

methods.name: isExtractable
methods.description: Checks if a private key attribute CKA_EXTRACTABLE is set to true.

methods.name: EnsurePKCS12Init
methods.description: Initializes PKCS#12 support, enabling ciphers and setting conversion functions.

methods.name: nsPKCS12Blob_Import
methods.description: Imports PKCS#12 data with support for empty password handling.

methods.name: nsPKCS12Blob_Export
methods.description: Exports certificates and keys into a PKCS#12 blob, handling encryption and attributes.
